basic_info.description: Spacious and updated condominium with peaceful forest views.  Ideally located on the top floor and situated at the end of the building, this unit offers tons of privacy with just the right number of modern updates.  One of the larger of the 1-bedroom units at Diamond Heights Village, this 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom features 1 car secured parking, wide plank wood floors, gas fireplace, an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances including dishwasher and recently replaced quartz countertops as well as an updated bathroom with shower and tub combination.  There is great storage space, large windows letting in tons of natural light, views of the common grounds lush with trees and it is a top floor end unit.  The community has a large common clubhouse, outdoor heated pool, jacuzzi, gym, onsite management and lush grounds complete with ponds and meandering walkways.
